text:
## Evidence and Escalation  
The account record must retain ownership and source-of-funds evidence, screening
results, risk rating, approver, and review date. Missing evidence, a positive
screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to
Financial Crime. Staff must not activate the account while the issue is open.
name: Chunk 4/5

raw_entities.name: Account Evidence and Escalation Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the retention of account evidence, screening results, and risk documentation, with mandatory escalation procedures to Financial Crime for missing evidence, positive screening results, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds. Prohibits account activation pending resolution of flagged issues.
context: The account record must retain ownership and source-of-funds evidence, screening results, risk rating, approver, and review date.
Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.
Staff must not activate the account while the issue is open.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Account Record Evidence Retention
raw_entities.description: Requires that account records retain ownership evidence, source-of-funds evidence, screening results, risk rating, approver identity, and review date as a condition of account management.
context: The account record must retain ownership and source-of-funds evidence, screening results, risk rating, approver, and review date.

raw_entities.name: Escalation of Missing Evidence to Financial Crime
raw_entities.description: Mandates referral to Financial Crime when account evidence is missing, including ownership documentation or source-of-funds verification.
context: Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.

raw_entities.name: Escalation of Positive Screening Results to Financial Crime
raw_entities.description: Requires immediate referral to Financial Crime when AML screening returns a positive result during account onboarding or review.
context: Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.

raw_entities.name: Escalation of Unclear Ownership to Financial Crime
raw_entities.description: Mandates referral to Financial Crime when account ownership cannot be clearly established or verified.
context: Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.

raw_entities.name: Escalation of Suspicious Funds to Financial Crime
raw_entities.description: Requires referral to Financial Crime when funds deposited to or held in an account are identified as suspicious or potentially illicit.
context: Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.

raw_entities.name: Prohibition on Account Activation During Open Issues
raw_entities.description: Prohibits staff from activating or opening an account while evidence gaps, screening issues, ownership concerns, or suspicious fund investigations remain unresolved.
context: Staff must not activate the account while the issue is open.

raw_entities.name: Missing Account Evidence
raw_entities.description: Risk arising from incomplete or absent ownership documentation, source-of-funds verification, or other required account evidence, creating compliance and AML exposure.
context: Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.

raw_entities.name: Positive AML Screening Result
raw_entities.description: Risk identified when AML screening (sanctions, PEP, or adverse media checks) returns a positive match or alert during account onboarding or periodic review.
context: Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.

raw_entities.name: Unclear Account Ownership
raw_entities.description: Risk arising when the beneficial owner, legal owner, or signatory authority on an account cannot be clearly identified or verified.
context: Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Funds
raw_entities.description: Risk identified when funds deposited to or held in an account are suspected to be proceeds of crime, illicit activity, or money laundering.
context: Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Function
raw_entities.description: Internal compliance function responsible for receiving and investigating escalations of missing evidence, positive screening results, unclear ownership, and suspicious funds. Acts as the escalation point for account onboarding and review issues.
context: Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.

raw_entities.name: Account Activation Staff
raw_entities.description: Bank staff responsible for account opening and activation. Under this policy, they are prohibited from activating accounts while evidence gaps, screening issues, or investigations remain open.
context: Staff must not activate the account while the issue is open.

raw_entities.name: Account Evidence Documentation and Retention
raw_entities.description: Control requiring maintenance of ownership evidence, source-of-funds documentation, screening results, risk rating, approver identity, and review date in the account record as an audit trail and compliance safeguard.
context: The account record must retain ownership and source-of-funds evidence, screening results, risk rating, approver, and review date.

raw_entities.name: Account Activation Gate
raw_entities.description: Operational control that prevents account activation until all evidence, screening, and ownership verification issues are resolved and cleared by Financial Crime.
context: Staff must not activate the account while the issue is open.

raw_entities.name: Account Screening Results Retention
raw_entities.description: Requirement to retain and document all AML screening results (sanctions, PEP, adverse media checks) in the account record, with positive results triggering mandatory escalation to Financial Crime.
context: The account record must retain ownership and source-of-funds evidence, screening results, risk rating, approver, and review date.
Missing evidence, a positive screening result, unclear ownership, or suspicious funds must be referred to Financial Crime.

raw_entities.name: New Account
raw_entities.description: Account subject to evidence retention, screening, and activation controls under this policy. The account record must retain all required documentation and screening results before activation is permitted.
context: The account record must retain ownership and source-of-funds evidence, screening results, risk rating, approver, and review date.
Staff must not activate the account while the issue is open.
